faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the IIT (ISM) Dhanbad Junior Research Fellow (JRF) recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the application form for the Junior Research Fellow (JRF) position at IIT (ISM) Dhanbad is 18th August 2026.

faq.question: Q2. What is the total number of vacancies for the Junior Research Fellow (JRF) post?
faq.answer: There is one vacancy for the Junior Research Fellow (JRF) position announced by IIT (ISM) Dhanbad.

faq.question: Q3. What is the educational qualification required for the JRF post?
faq.answer: Candidates need a Graduate degree (B.E./B.Tech) or Postgraduate degree (M.E./M.Tech) in relevant engineering disciplines with a First Division and must be GATE-qualified.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for the Junior Research Fellow (JRF) position?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for the Junior Research Fellow (JRF) post is 35 years, with age relaxation applicable as per Government of India norms.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary offered for the JRF position?
faq.answer: The selected candidate for the Junior Research Fellow (JRF) position will receive a monthly stipend of Rs. 37,000 plus HRA.

faq.question: Q6. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC/SC/ST) for this recruitment.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for the Junior Research Fellow (JRF) role?
faq.answer: The selection process involves shortlisting candidates based on merit, followed by an interview, which can be conducted online or physically.

faq.question: Q8. What is the job type for this position?
faq.answer: The Junior Research Fellow (JRF) position at IIT (ISM) Dhanbad is a contractual role.

faq.question: Q9. Where can I find the official notification for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The official notification PDF link is available in the "Important Links" section of this article.

faq.question: Q10. How can I apply for the Junior Research Fellow (JRF) position?
faq.answer: Applications must be submitted online through the official IIT (ISM) Dhanbad website or the direct application link provided in the "Important Links" section before the last date.
